name: gg-uk-treaty-employment-and-relief
description: Apply the UK–Guernsey treaty's residence and ordinary employment-income tests and prepare a Guernsey foreign-tax-credit working paper. Covers territorial scope, individual and entity residence conflicts, the three short-visit employment conditions, the credit ceiling, permanent establishments, business-profit attribution, associated-enterprise adjustments, dividend/interest/royalty conditions, pensions and government-service distinctions, student support, capital-gains allocation, offshore overrides, mutual-agreement time limits and the published arbitration procedure with an official status discrepancy. Includes domestic treaty-credit and unilateral-relief limits, claim periods and later tax adjustments, with checked day-count and credit examples. Based on the official 2018 Agreement and Protocol and current HMRC treaty-status evidence checked in October 2026. This source-cited draft does not establish payroll clearance, all withholding categories, claim forms or complete cross-border
